LanguageData.SSC_UterusDevelopment_DescriptionDevelop: Purple nanomachines have settled within the womb, reshaping it day by day. This body is still far from ready to nurture new life; only repeated, deep-reaching pleasure can feed it toward maturity, little by little.
LanguageData.SSC_UterusDevelopment_DescriptionInferti: The womb has been fully developed, turning this body into a seductive vessel made solely for pleasure. No longer distracted by childbearing, it devotes all its strength to healing wounds and dispelling fatigue more quickly.
LanguageData.SSC_UterusDevelopment_DescriptionFertile: The womb has been fully developed into a chamber always ready to conceive. This body conceives more easily than an ordinary one, and once pregnant, its gestation is shorter as well.
